content:
Report Download Testing অনেকেই শুধু "ফাইলটি download হয়েছে কিনা" পরীক্ষা করে শেষ করেন। কিন্তু file-এর ভেতরের ডেটা সঠিক কিনা, বড় data set-এ কতক্ষণ লাগে, empty report কীভাবে দেখায় — এগুলো না দেখলে QA অসম্পূর্ণ।

---

Positive Test Cases

TC-RPT-001: Download report as PDF
Method: GET /api/reports/sales?format=pdf&from=2026-01-01&to=2026-06-30
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Content-Type: application/pdf
  - Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="sales-report-2026.pdf"
  - File opens in PDF reader without error

TC-RPT-002: Download report as Excel (.xlsx)
Query: format=xlsx
Expected:
  - Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
  - File opens in Excel, columns properly formatted

TC-RPT-003: Download report as CSV
Query: format=csv
Expected:
  - Content-Type: text/csv
  - First row is header row
  - Data rows match expected records
---

Data Accuracy Tests

TC-RPT-004: Report data matches UI data
Steps:
  1. View Sales data on dashboard for Q1 (Jan-Mar 2026)
  2. Download PDF report for same period
Expected: Total sales, record count, and data in PDF match dashboard exactly

TC-RPT-005: Date range filter accuracy
Query: from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-31
Expected: Report contains ONLY March 2026 records — no overflow to Feb or Apr

TC-RPT-006: Column headers match specification
Expected: Column names in exported file match API documentation / UI column labels
---

Edge Case Tests

TC-RPT-007: Empty date range (no records)
Query: from=2020-01-01&to=2020-01-02 (no data exists)
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - File downloaded successfully
  - File contains header row only, no data rows
  - NOT 404 or empty response

TC-RPT-008: Single-day report
Query: from=2026-06-15&to=2026-06-15
Expected: Only records from that single day

TC-RPT-009: Unsupported format
Query: format=docx
Expected: 400, "Supported formats: pdf, xlsx, csv."

TC-RPT-010: Missing date range parameters
Query: (no from/to)
Expected: 400, "Date range is required." OR default to last 30 days (documented)
---

Performance Tests

TC-RPT-011: Large dataset export (10,000+ records)
Expected:
  - Download completes within acceptable time (e.g., < 30 seconds)
  - No server timeout (504)
  - Streamed response (not loading all into memory)

TC-RPT-012: Concurrent report download by 10 users
Steps: 10 users request same report simultaneously
Expected: All receive complete files, no partial downloads, no server crash
---

পরিশেষে

Report Download Testing-এ সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হলো Data Accuracy — UI ও Report-এর ডেটা মিলছে কিনা। এছাড়া Large Dataset Performance এবং Concurrent Download — দুটো Production-এ সবচেয়ে বেশি সমস্যা তৈরি করে।
